meta: Gym trainers write workout plans with AI: twenty clients, each with a different goal, and AI helps write a plan for each.

muc.title: Twenty clients
muc.text: A gym trainer has twenty clients, each with a different goal. AI helps write a plan for each one.

muc.title: Four weeks, step by step
muc.text: Enter the goal, number of sessions and equipment into a chatbot and ask for a four-week plan.

muc.title: Notes after every session
muc.text: After each session, write down weights, reps and how it felt. At the end of the week, ask AI to sum up progress so you can adjust.

muc.title: Medical conditions need a doctor
muc.text: Use client codes instead of real names. Anyone with heart problems or injuries should check with a doctor first.

muc.title: A weekly summary message
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to write a weekly summary message for one client, with one thing to praise and one to work on.
